components.name: Primary button
components.css: .ds-button { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; cursor:pointer; white-space:nowrap; border-radius:calc(var(--radius,.75rem) - 2px); font:500 14px/20px var(--font-body,Inter,sans-serif); height:40px; padding:8px 16px; transition:color 150ms,background-color 150ms,border-color 150ms; } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px hsl(var(--background,220 20% 97%)),0 0 0 4px hsl(var(--ring,221 83% 53%)); } .ds-button:disabled { pointer-events:none; opacity:.5; } .ds-button-primary {background:hsl(var(--primary,221 83% 53%)); color:hsl(var(--primary-foreground,0 0% 100%)); border:0;} .ds-button-primary:hover {background:hsl(var(--primary,221 83% 53%)/.9);}

components.name: Outline button
components.css: .ds-button { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; cursor:pointer; white-space:nowrap; border-radius:calc(var(--radius,.75rem) - 2px); font:500 14px/20px var(--font-body,Inter,sans-serif); height:40px; padding:8px 16px; transition:color 150ms,background-color 150ms,border-color 150ms; } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px hsl(var(--background,220 20% 97%)),0 0 0 4px hsl(var(--ring,221 83% 53%)); } .ds-button:disabled { pointer-events:none; opacity:.5; } .ds-button-outline {background:hsl(var(--background,220 20% 97%)); color:hsl(var(--foreground,222 47% 11%)); border:1px solid hsl(var(--input,220 13% 91%));} .ds-button-outline:hover {background:hsl(var(--accent,262 83% 58%)); color:hsl(var(--accent-foreground,0 0% 100%));}

components.name: Ghost button
components.css: .ds-button { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; cursor:pointer; white-space:nowrap; border-radius:calc(var(--radius,.75rem) - 2px); font:500 14px/20px var(--font-body,Inter,sans-serif); height:40px; padding:8px 16px; transition:color 150ms,background-color 150ms,border-color 150ms; } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px hsl(var(--background,220 20% 97%)),0 0 0 4px hsl(var(--ring,221 83% 53%)); } .ds-button:disabled { pointer-events:none; opacity:.5; } .ds-button-ghost {background:transparent; color:hsl(var(--foreground,222 47% 11%)); border:0;} .ds-button-ghost:hover {background:hsl(var(--accent,262 83% 58%)); color:hsl(var(--accent-foreground,0 0% 100%));}

components.name: Input
components.description: Shared text field; inspector overrides text to 13px.
components.css: .ds-input { width:100%; height:40px; border:1px solid hsl(var(--input,220 13% 91%)); border-radius:calc(var(--radius,.75rem) - 2px); padding:8px 12px; background:hsl(var(--background,220 20% 97%)); color:hsl(var(--foreground,222 47% 11%)); font:400 16px/24px var(--font-body,Inter,sans-serif); } .ds-input::placeholder { color:hsl(var(--muted-foreground,220 9% 46%)); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px hsl(var(--background,220 20% 97%)),0 0 0 4px hsl(var(--ring,221 83% 53%)); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity:.5; cursor:not-allowed; } @media(min-width:768px) { .ds-input { font-size:14px; line-height:20px; } }

components.name: Card
components.css: .ds-card { background:hsl(var(--card,0 0% 100%)); color:hsl(var(--card-foreground,222 47% 11%)); border:1px solid hsl(var(--border,220 13% 91%)); border-radius:var(--radius,.75rem); box-shadow:0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0/.05); font-family:var(--font-body,Inter,sans-serif); } .ds-card-content { padding:24px; }

components.name: Selected slide thumbnail
components.description: Selected rail button with miniature content; sample copy is illustrative.
components.css: .ds-thumbnail { width:140px; padding:6px; text-align:left; border-radius:8px; border:1px solid hsl(var(--primary,221 83% 53%)); background:hsl(var(--primary,221 83% 53%)/.04); color:hsl(var(--foreground,222 47% 11%)); font:400 12px/16px var(--font-body,Inter,sans-serif); cursor:pointer; } .ds-mini { display:block; aspect-ratio:16/9; padding:6%; margin-bottom:8px; background:#fff; color:#18181b; border:1px solid hsl(var(--border,220 13% 91%)); font-family:var(--font-display,Plus Jakarta Sans,sans-serif); font-weight:700; } .ds-thumbnail:hover { background:hsl(var(--muted,220 14% 96%)); } .ds-thumbnail:focus-visible { outline:2px solid hsl(var(--ring,221 83% 53%)); outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview: SlideCraft uses its existing light application shell: pale background, white surfaces, dark text, blue actions, and rounded controls. The live editor extends that system with a slide rail, central artifact, and external inspector. The approved editor structure does not establish a new brand identity.
keyCharacteristics: Actual slide content in the canvas and thumbnails.
Grayscale content draft followed by complete AI designs per slide; selected slide and actions use the existing blue.
Inspector controls stay outside the slide.
Final preview and editable PowerPoint share one native text-and-rectangle scene.
Independent section headings/text stay together through design and automatic rendered review.
dos: Do reuse the existing application color and typography tokens.
Do render real slide text, process steps, bars, and source labels in both canvas and thumbnails.
Do keep the selected thumbnail visible when the rail becomes horizontal.
Do use success-strong and warning-strong for status text on light surfaces.
Do show actual per-slide design states and preserve accepted content and completed designs during retries.
Do preserve the reviewed composition family and exact accepted visuals while keeping the selected theme background consistent.
Do preserve section heading/text bindings and accepted visuals through automatic design refinement.
Do keep measured and model critique internal; show the candidate, progress, and concise retry controls.
donts: Don't place editor controls inside the slide artifact.
Don't treat a suggested excerpt or copied chart numbers as verified evidence.
Don't apply a new identity to the existing application shell.
Don't describe numeric provenance checks as factual verification or simulate final-design token streaming.
Don't equate automatic rendered approval with factual verification, identical PowerPoint pixels, or guaranteed success for every input.
Don't mark an unresolved quality candidate ready or export it.
